title: How Truemed Made Red Light Therapy Accessible

segments.note: Cold open with the direct proof: HigherDose was found through Truemed and purchased through FSA dollars.
Interviewer sets up why red light therapy mattered.
Stephanie explains the health reason for red light therapy: sweat, detox, mitochondria, and healthy cells.
Interviewer bridges from red light benefits into product discovery and Truemed.
Stephanie lists the HigherDose products and makes the use case practical: she rotates them into normal life.
Quick prompt for what each device is useful for.
Device-by-device payoff: hair regrowth, collagen, full-body mat use.
Closes the value argument: HSA/FSA dollars can decide whether someone buys a health-changing product.
